title: Final demonstration and explanation
goal: Demonstrate the policy assistant and explain its limits with evidence.
case: A fresh student question and a previously unseen failure are presented.
terms: The student question enters retrieval, access checks, answer construction and evaluation.
Each learner shows the part they changed and explains the choice.
A new example of a practised failure tests understanding rather than memorization.
Another person can run, test and review the solution from written instructions.
steps: Run an answerable student policy question
Explain one failure and propose a new test
example: P4: appeals must be filed within ten days.
Q: May I appeal on day 12?
A: No; the ten-day window has passed [P4], subject to the policy version used.
misconception: A polished demonstration without tests establishes that the system is ready.
correction: Show the test cases, negative cases, access result and remaining limitations.
change: Use a new policy version and explain which index and tests must change.
metric: Task success, citation support, no-answer accuracy and access gate
lab: Present a self-contained end-to-end policy assistant.
output: Demo, test table, known limits and individual explanation.
